snippet.title: Game Boy Color Longplay [155] Mr. Nutz (US)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Charly9631

A better port than GBC, but much slower because of more "wavy" transition each scenes, and more colorful game compared to the GB port.

The game calculate the % complete based on the amount of coins you collected in a level (including secret areas). Every perfect level, the game adds an extra credit so you don't have to worry about getting a game over. There are 2,209 coins in this game, so try your best to reach that number if you can :P

Here I collected ALL the coins that can possibly be found, because I want to be the first to complete this game 100%, ofc :P

I did have some struggles while playing this, especially the screen is pretty small, which is why I can't really see what's ahead and what's above/below, and if you play this, you may get hit tons of times, or eventually, DEATH!!!

The hardest boss for me is the little clown, since you have to time perfectly before jumping on its flying head, otherwise you ill end up being hit.

But other than that, the game itself is pretty easy, but it's hard to know where the secret area is, and ofc, hard to get 100% too.

As always, enjoy this longplay! :)

Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
